about: Sideways Tactics & strategy paints exactly one 'Menu and settings' button (the one in its own bar) and none under or over the tab rail. Gate 149 run with CT_149_TAC_ONLY=1 (its Tactics blocks only); graded lines are TC-R225k: the rail is found, ONE menu, every rail tab answers its own tap. Windows are the gate's own computer-sized ones: it is a desktop-width defect (the page-level button is drawn only when `wide`), so kunal761 and 320x568 are not situations; the phone's own menu is covered by other gates. NOT COVERED: how the single menu looks to him on a computer.

breaks.name: page-level-menu-is-back
breaks.why: the original defect: the page-level menu is drawn again on sideways Tactics (beside the group at 1920, under the rail's Home tab on laptops)

breaks.name: no-menu-of-its-own
breaks.why: the other way to get it wrong: Tactics's own bar menu is dropped as well, so there is no menu button at all

breaks.name: back-on-the-widest-windows
breaks.why: the guard narrowed so the second button returns only at 1700 wide and over (1920x1080, 2560x1320), where it sits beside the group
